<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>帝王详情 · 商业化重设计</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#0c0907; --panel:#15100d; --panel2:#1b1410; --gold:#d7ad57; --gold2:#f4d98e;
  --text:#f3e6c8; --muted:#9f8b68; --line:rgba(215,173,87,.18); --deep:#090604;
  --red:#6f261d; --red2:#a74634; --shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.58);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#080604;color:var(--text);font-family:"Songti SC","STSong","Noto Serif SC",serif}
body{background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%,rgba(151,91,38,.20),transparent 36%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,#110b08 0%,#080604 55%,#070503 100%);}
button{font:inherit}
.page{width:min(100%,720px);margin:0 auto;min-height:100vh;padding:16px 14px 30px}
.frame{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(24,17,13,.985),rgba(14,10,8,.99));box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.34)}
.frame:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,.018),transparent 18%,transparent 82%,rgba(255,255,255,.012));}
.top{height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(8,6,4,.36);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
.top .title{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.top h1{margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold2)}
.top .caption{font-size:11px;color:#7e6c50;letter-spacing:.1em}
.close{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);color:#d7bd80;font-size:22px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:285px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;align-items:end;gap:18px;padding:22px 26px 0;background:
 linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,6,4,.2),rgba(8,6,4,.86) 66%),
 radial-gradient(circle at 22% 35%,rgba(153,95,39,.18),transparent 42%);}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(13,9,7,.95));pointer-events:none}
.portrait-area{align-self:stretch;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
.portrait-area:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:175px;height:175px;border-radius:50%;bottom:38px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(219,178,87,.16),rgba(219,178,87,.02) 55%,transparent 72%);filter:blur(2px)}
.portrait{position:relative;z-index:2;width:205px;height:258px;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55));}
.identity{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 0 40px;min-width:0}
.name{font-size:38px;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#f3d889;text-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);white-space:nowrap}
.meta{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:#b49a6d;line-height:1.8}
.meta strong{font-weight:500;color:#d6bb7d}
.desc{margin-top:14px;max-width:340px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:#8d7a5e}
.tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);height:54px;background:#100b08;border-top:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.12);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.14)}
.tab{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#7f6d50;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.tab.active{color:#efd285}
.tab.active:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:30%;right:30%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#dcb55f;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(220,181,95,.32)}
.content{padding:18px 20px 110px}
.panel{display:none} .panel.active{display:block}
.section{padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.11)}
.section:first-child{padding-top:0}
.section:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.section-title{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#e6c97f}
.section-note{font-size:10px;color:#6f604a}
.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.info{padding:12px 13px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.018);border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.12)}
.info label{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#77664d;margin-bottom:7px}
.info .val{font-size:14px;color:#ead39b;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px 20px}
.metric{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px 34px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.metric .label{font-size:12px;color:#b59c6e}
.metric b{font-size:14px;color:#f0cf77;font-weight:600;text-align:right}
.track{height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:#080604;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.fill{height:100%;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8b3929,#d5a94e);transform-origin:left;animation:grow .75s ease both}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleX(.1)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
.summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.summary-item{padding:14px 12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(215,173,87,.055),rgba(215,173,87,.015));border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.13);text-align:center}
.summary-item span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#77664d;margin-bottom:6px}
.summary-item b{font-size:20px;color:#efcf7c;font-weight:500}
.text-block{font-size:13px;line-height:1.95;color:#aa9571}
.rel-list,.timeline{display:grid;gap:10px}
.rel{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 15px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.018);border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.11)}
.rel strong{font-size:14px;color:#e5cc93;font-weight:500}
.rel small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:10px;color:#75664f}
.rel .score{font-size:18px;color:#e0bd67}
.event{display:grid;grid-template-columns:74px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:8px 0}
.event time{font-size:11px;color:#7e6c50;padding-top:2px}
.event p{margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:#aa9571}

.category-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;padding:5px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.018);border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.10)}
.category-btn{min-height:54px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:#8d7957;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px}
.category-btn b{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em}.category-btn small{font-size:10px;color:#685a43}
.category-btn.active{color:#f0d083;border-color:rgba(215,173,87,.35);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(131,55,32,.58),rgba(87,31,20,.42));box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.035)}
.category-btn.active small{color:#c7a667}
.category-bar.history-cats{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}
.relationship-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}
.person-card{padding:14px 14px 12px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.022),rgba(255,255,255,.010));border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.15);transition:.18s ease}
.person-card:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:rgba(215,173,87,.28)}
.person-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.12)}
.person-name{font-size:15px;color:#e8cf93;letter-spacing:.05em}.role-tag{font-size:10px;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;color:#d6b773;background:rgba(126,54,31,.42);border:1px solid rgba(167,77,42,.45);white-space:nowrap}
.person-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:11px}.person-stat{min-width:0}.person-stat-line{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:#7b694d;margin-bottom:6px}.person-stat-line b{font-size:13px;color:#e4c26d;font-weight:500}.mini-track{height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:#080604;overflow:hidden}.mini-fill{height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9b4330,#d5a94e)}
.empty-state{display:none;padding:44px 0;text-align:center;color:#75654d;font-size:12px}.empty-state.show{display:block}
.timeline-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:4px 0 8px;font-size:10px;color:#6e5f48}.history-list{position:relative;padding-left:20px}.history-list:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:4px;top:7px;bottom:7px;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(215,173,87,.40),rgba(215,173,87,.08))}
.history-event{position:relative;padding:10px 0 13px 14px}.history-event:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-19px;top:16px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#c99232;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1b120c}.history-event+.history-event{border-top:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.08)}
.history-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px}.history-date{font-size:11px;color:#c2a364}.history-type{font-size:9px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:999px;color:#d0aa62;background:rgba(123,50,27,.38);border:1px solid rgba(164,72,38,.40)}.history-text{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#b8a17a}
.filter-hidden{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:600px){.relationship-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.category-btn{min-height:50px}.category-bar{gap:5px}.category-bar.history-cats{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}.category-btn b{font-size:12px}}

.footer{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:14px 18px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.35fr;gap:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,9,7,0),rgba(13,9,7,.96) 26%,rgba(13,9,7,.995));backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.btn{height:50px;border-radius:15px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.06em}
.btn.secondary{border:1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.25);background:#130d0a;color:#bba472}
.btn.primary{border:1px solid #e0bb68;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eccd7c,#c99a3c);color:#2e1d0b;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(183,132,44,.18)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:28px;transform:translate(-50%,18px);padding:10px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:#ecd181;color:#2a1b0b;font-size:12px;opacity:0;transition:.2s;pointer-events:none;z-index:99}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .page{padding:0}
  .frame{min-height:100vh;border-radius:0;border-left:0;border-right:0}
  .top{height:58px;padding:0 16px}
  .top .caption{display:none}
  .hero{grid-template-columns:145px 1fr;min-height:235px;padding:16px 16px 0;gap:10px}
  .portrait{width:150px;height:210px}
  .identity{padding-bottom:30px}
  .name{font-size:30px}
  .desc{display:none}
  .content{padding:16px 16px 105px}
  .metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .info-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .info{padding:10px 9px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">
  <main class="frame" id="frame">
    <header class="top">
      <div class="title"><h1>帝王详情</h1><span class="caption">人物档案</span></div>
      <button class="close" aria-label="关闭" onclick="document.getElementById('frame').style.opacity='.28'">×</button>
    </header>

    <section class="hero">
      <div class="portrait-area"><img class="portrait" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="皇帝立绘"></div>
      <div class="identity">
        <div class="name">萧承曜</div>
        <div class="meta"><strong>大曜皇帝</strong> · 永和三年<br>42岁 · 在位第三年 · 安康</div>
        <div class="desc">少历军政，登极后崇尚务实治国。朝局渐稳，民望正盛。</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <nav class="tabs">
      <div class="tab active" data-tab="overview">御览</div>
      <div class="tab" data-tab="relations">关系 135</div>
      <div class="tab" data-tab="history">履历 747</div>
    </nav>

    <section class="content">
      <div class="panel active" id="overview">
        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-head"><div class="section-title">身份信息</div><div class="section-note">点击底部按钮可编辑</div></div>
          <div class="info-grid">
            <div class="info"><label>名讳</label><div class="val editable">萧承曜</div></div>
            <div class="info"><label>年号</label><div class="val editable">永和</div></div>
            <div class="info"><label>宗室</label><div class="val editable">萧氏</div></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-head"><div class="section-title">帝王六维</div><div class="section-note">满值 100</div></div>
          <div class="metrics">
            <div class="metric"><span class="label">文治</span><b>72</b><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:72%"></div></div></div>
            <div class="metric"><span class="label">武略</span><b>58</b><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:58%"></div></div></div>
            <div class="metric"><span class="label">政治</span><b>66</b><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:66%"></div></div></div>
            <div class="metric"><span class="label">民生</span><b>61</b><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:61%"></div></div></div>
            <div class="metric"><span class="label">魅力</span><b>78</b><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:78%"></div></div></div>
            <div class="metric"><span class="label">健康</span><b>83</b><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:83%"></div></div></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-head"><div class="section-title">统治概览</div></div>
          <div class="summary">
            <div class="summary-item"><span>朝廷稳定</span><b>82</b></div>
            <div class="summary-item"><span>民望</span><b>74</b></div>
            <div class="summary-item"><span>国库</span><b>68</b></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel" id="relations">
        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-head"><div class="section-title">人物关系</div><div class="section-note">分类查阅</div></div>
          <div class="category-bar" id="relationCats">
            <button class="category-btn active" data-rel="harem"><b>后宫</b><small>39</small></button>
            <button class="category-btn" data-rel="clan"><b>宗亲</b><small>40</small></button>
            <button class="category-btn" data-rel="court"><b>朝臣</b><small>56</small></button>
            <button class="category-btn" data-rel="inner"><b>内廷</b><small>0</small></button>
          </div>
          <div class="relationship-grid" id="relationshipGrid">
            <article class="person-card" data-rel-card="harem"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">沈皇后</div><span class="role-tag">皇贵妃</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>100</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:100%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>100</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:100%"></div></div></div></div></article>
            <article class="person-card" data-rel-card="harem"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">孝和太后</div><span class="role-tag">皇太后</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>88</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:88%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>91</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:91%"></div></div></div></div></article>
            <article class="person-card" data-rel-card="harem"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">荣贵妃</div><span class="role-tag">太妃</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>67</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:67%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>74</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:74%"></div></div></div></div></article>
            <article class="person-card" data-rel-card="harem"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">许令仪</div><span class="role-tag">妃</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>74</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:74%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>58</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:58%"></div></div></div></div></article>
            <article class="person-card filter-hidden" data-rel-card="clan"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">萧景珩</div><span class="role-tag">宁王</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>82</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:82%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>77</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:77%"></div></div></div></div></article>
            <article class="person-card filter-hidden" data-rel-card="clan"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">萧明棠</div><span class="role-tag">长公主</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>91</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:91%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>85</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:85%"></div></div></div></div></article>
            <article class="person-card filter-hidden" data-rel-card="court"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">顾玄礼</div><span class="role-tag">丞相</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>64</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:64%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>79</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:79%"></div></div></div></div></article>
            <article class="person-card filter-hidden" data-rel-card="court"><div class="person-top"><div class="person-name">裴度</div><span class="role-tag">大将军</span></div><div class="person-stats"><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>亲近</span><b>71</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:71%"></div></div></div><div class="person-stat"><div class="person-stat-line"><span>信任</span><b>88</b></div><div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:88%"></div></div></div></div></article>
          </div>
          <div class="empty-state" id="relationEmpty">暂无内廷关系记录</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel" id="history">
        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-head"><div class="section-title">近期履历</div><div class="section-note">由近及远 · 最多显示20条</div></div>
          <div class="category-bar history-cats" id="historyCats">
            <button class="category-btn active" data-his="all"><b>全部</b><small>752</small></button>
            <button class="category-btn" data-his="court"><b>前朝</b><small>283</small></button>
            <button class="category-btn" data-his="harem"><b>后宫</b><small>260</small></button>
            <button class="category-btn" data-his="heir"><b>子嗣</b><small>196</small></button>
            <button class="category-btn" data-his="personal"><b>个人</b><small>13</small></button>
          </div>
          <div class="timeline-head"><span>时间线</span><span id="historyHint">全部记录</span></div>
          <div class="history-list" id="historyList">
            <article class="history-event" data-his-card="court"><div class="history-meta"><span class="history-date">永和21年 · 10月1日</span><span class="history-type">前朝</span></div><div class="history-text">户部于本月初一发放月俸 12140 两。</div></article>
            <article class="history-event" data-his-card="harem"><div class="history-meta"><span class="history-date">永和21年 · 9月29日</span><span class="history-type">后宫</span></div><div class="history-text">沈皇后由皇后调整为皇贵妃。</div></article>
            <article class="history-event" data-his-card="heir"><div class="history-meta"><span class="history-date">永和21年 · 9月27日</span><span class="history-type">子嗣</span></div><div class="history-text">皇帝与沈皇后继续闲聊，并选择“今日到此”。皇帝向沈皇后颔首，今日闲谈便到此为止。</div></article>
            <article class="history-event" data-his-card="heir"><div class="history-meta"><span class="history-date">永和21年 · 9月27日</span><span class="history-type">子嗣</span></div><div class="history-text">皇帝与沈皇后交谈，并答复“准她操办”。皇帝准许她单力操办小宴，六宫节庆气氛更和乐。</div></article>
            <article class="history-event" data-his-card="harem"><div class="history-meta"><span class="history-date">永和21年 · 9月27日</span><span class="history-type">后宫</span></div><div class="history-text">顾婉仪由答应调整为常在，宠爱 +6。</div></article>
            <article class="history-event" data-his-card="personal"><div class="history-meta"><span class="history-date">永和21年 · 9月25日</span><span class="history-type">个人</span></div><div class="history-text">御医请平安脉，帝体安康，健康 +1。</div></article>
            <article class="history-event" data-his-card="court"><div class="history-meta"><span class="history-date">永和21年 · 9月23日</span><span class="history-type">前朝</span></div><div class="history-text">召见丞相顾玄礼议边饷，批准北境秋防支出。</div></article>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="footer">
      <button class="btn secondary" id="editBtn">编辑信息</button>
      <button class="btn primary" id="saveBtn">保存帝王信息</button>
    </footer>
  </main>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast">帝王信息已保存</div>
<script>
const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')];
tabs.forEach(t=>t.onclick=()=>{tabs.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));document.querySelectorAll('.panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));t.classList.add('active');document.getElementById(t.dataset.tab).classList.add('active')});

const relationBtns=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-rel]')];
const relationCards=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-rel-card]')];
const relationEmpty=document.getElementById('relationEmpty');
relationBtns.forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  relationBtns.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active');
  const key=btn.dataset.rel; let shown=0;
  relationCards.forEach(card=>{const hit=card.dataset.relCard===key;card.classList.toggle('filter-hidden',!hit);if(hit)shown++;});
  relationEmpty.classList.toggle('show',shown===0);
}));

const historyBtns=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-his]')];
const historyCards=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-his-card]')];
const historyHint=document.getElementById('historyHint');
const historyNames={all:'全部记录',court:'前朝履历',harem:'后宫履历',heir:'子嗣履历',personal:'个人履历'};
historyBtns.forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  historyBtns.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active');
  const key=btn.dataset.his;
  historyCards.forEach(card=>card.classList.toggle('filter-hidden',key!=='all'&&card.dataset.hisCard!==key));
  historyHint.textContent=historyNames[key];
}));

let editing=false;
const editBtn=document.getElementById('editBtn');
editBtn.onclick=()=>{editing=!editing;document.querySelectorAll('.editable').forEach(el=>{el.contentEditable=editing;el.style.outline=editing?'1px solid rgba(215,173,87,.35)':'none';el.style.borderRadius='6px';});editBtn.textContent=editing?'完成编辑':'编辑信息';};
document.getElementById('saveBtn').onclick=()=>{const toast=document.getElementById('toast');toast.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),1500)};
</script>
</body>
</html>
